figures.caption: Figure 1: Overview of POLAR+. The cache controller (slow timescale) updates the resident set 𝐶ℓ at each epoch boundary; the LinUCB router (fast timescale) selects an adapter for each request 𝑥𝑡 . The libraryM holds 𝑁 adapters on SSD; the GPU keeps a resident set of size 𝐾 that evolves 𝐶1 → 𝐶2 → 𝐶3 → 𝐶4 ≈ 𝐶† as epoch lengths double (green “+” marks newly admitted adapters). Request 𝑥3 hits a cached adapter (hot path); request 𝑥8 needs an evicted adapter and pays the cold-path penalty.
